name: @tinyhaptic/mascot
description: The Tiny Haptic mascot: a plain JavaScript core, React and Astro components, and its icons.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.json && bun -e 'import { css } from "./dist/css.js"; await Bun.write("mascot.css", `/* Written by the build from src/css.ts. */\n${css}`)' && chmod +x dist/cli.js
